parameters.description: Item ID. E.g. '414600577'. This can be retrieved from the search results of the SearchProducts tool.

tools.name: SearchProducts

parameters.name: keywords
parameters.description: Keywords to search for. E.g. 'apple iphone' or 'samsung galaxy'

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: Sort the results by the specified criteria. Defaults to 'relevance_according_to_keywords_searched'.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum price to filter the results by. E.g. 100.00

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum price to filter the results by. E.g. 100.00

parameters.name: next_day_delivery
parameters.description: Filters products that are eligible for next day delivery. Defaults to False (returns all products, regardless of delivery status).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum results to return (1-50). Defaults to 20.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of results to skip before the first returned item. Defaults to 0.

summary:
## Walmart Toolkit

The Walmart toolkit provides Arcade tools for searching and retrieving product data from Walmart's catalog via SerpAPI, enabling LLM agents to query products and fetch detailed listings programmatically.

## Capabilities

- **Product search**: Query Walmart's product catalog with keyword-based search, returning paginated results with `has_more` and `next_offset` for continuation (note: `total_count` is not available due to SerpAPI limitations).
- **Product details**: Retrieve structured product information for a specific Walmart item by ID or URL.

## Secrets

This toolkit requires one secret:

- **`SERP_API_KEY`**: An API key issued by [SerpAPI](https://serpapi.com/), the service used to query Walmart search results. To obtain it: create an account at [serpapi.com](https://serpapi.com/users/sign_up), then find your private API key on the [API Key page in your SerpAPI dashboard](https://serpapi.com/manage-api-key). Free-tier accounts have a limited monthly search quota; paid plans are required for higher volume. The key must be kept secret and is used to authenticate all outbound requests from the toolkit to SerpAPI.

Store this secret in Arcade using the [Secrets documentation](https://docs.arcade.dev/en/guides/create-tools/tool-basics/create-tool-secrets) or directly via the [Arcade dashboard](https://api.arcade.dev/dashboard/auth/secrets).
